data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's justification is logically unsupported and directly contradicts the audit standard. The target states the flags are sustained 'NOT because of independent discovery, but because SRC_006 and SRC_008 confirm a self-consistency property.' This reasoning is a non-sequitur. The audit criterion (§11.3, adjudication-ritual) requires sustained flags to be grounded in the failure of the specific problem as stated. Self-consistency of the falsificationist stance across instances (even if confirmed by SRC_006/SRC_008) merely proves internal logical preservation; it does not establish that the audited target failed the required problem. Furthermore, using other sources to justify sustaining a flag directly contradicts the target's own dismissal of independent discovery, revealing an internal inconsistency in its rationale.
